beg.name: Beg
beg.description: Instantly downgrade all <c=midrow>missiles in the midrow</c> into normal <c=drone>missiles</c>.

grazer.name: Grazer
grazer.description: Every time this ship's attack misses the enemy by exactly 1 space, the enemy takes {0} damage.

brutal.name: BRUTAL
brutal.description:
<c=artifact>BRUTAL</c>: Take a <c=downside>downside</c> on boot sequence
Events are harder
Start combat with a <c=downside>BRITTLE</c> cockpit
Your basic cards have worse upgrades
+1 <c=card>Basic Shot</c>
+1 <c=card>Corrupted Core</c>
Less pre-upgraded card offerings
-3 max hull
1 less max hull gained from boss kills
Elites only offer 2 artifacts
Start with 50% hull missing
Most enemies are harder!
Shuffling your deck adds a <c=card>Fatigue</c> to your draw pile
You can no longer have more than 7 <c=status>EVADE</c> at a time.

cosmic.name: COSMIC
cosmic.description:
<c=artifact>COSMIC</c>: Take a <c=downside>downside</c> on boot sequence
Events are harder
Start combat with a <c=downside>BRITTLE</c> cockpit
Your basic cards have worse upgrades
+1 <c=card>Basic Shot</c>
+1 <c=card>Corrupted Core</c>
Less pre-upgraded card offerings
-3 max hull
1 less max hull gained from boss kills
Elites only offer 2 artifacts
Start with 50% hull missing
Shuffling your deck adds a <c=card>Fatigue</c> to your draw pile
You can no longer have more than 7 <c=status>EVADE</c> at a time
All enemies and bosses are EVEN HARDER!

HarderEnemies.name: HARDER ENEMIES
HarderEnemies.description:
Enemies are harder.

<c=faint>Normally a part of Hardest difficulty.</c>

EvenHarderEnemies.name: EVEN HARDER ENEMIES
EvenHarderEnemies.description:
Enemies in later zones are way harder.

<c=faint>Normally a part of Cosmic difficulty.</c>

EvadeCap.name: EVADE CAP
EvadeCap.description:
You can not have more than 7 <c=status>EVADE</c> at a time.

<c=faint>Normally a part of Brutal difficulty.</c>

WorseBasics.name: WORSE BASICS
WorseBasics.description:
Your starting Basic cards have worse upgrades.

<c=faint>Normally a part of Brutal difficulty.</c>

TrashOnShuffle.name: FATIGUE
TrashOnShuffle.description:
Every time your discard pile is shuffled back into your draw pile, add a <c=card>Fatigue</c> to your draw pile.

<c=faint>Normally a part of Brutal difficulty.</c>
